newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bond confirms Wascana ratings.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bond confirms Wascana ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it confirmed Wascana Energy Inc long-term unsecured debt at BBB(High) with a stable trend.

"Net earnings before special items in the first nine months of 1996 declined by almost 70 percent due almost entirely to the fact that the company is now subject to income taxes for the first time," the agency said.
One a pre-tax basis, earnings were 15 percent lower.
DBRS said oil reserve additions have more than replaced Wascana's production this year and production is rising.
The positive impact of Wascana's higher production and climbing world oil prices have been offset by lower gas prices and the continuing run-down in natural gas reserves for the last five years.
"Debt has increased moderately, but the debt-to-cash-flow ratio of 1.1 times remains favourable and better than industry standards of 1.5 to 2.0 times," the agency said.
((Sarah Edmonds, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8100, E-mail sarah.edmonds@reuters.com))
